trigger.novelty_evidence: Binance published a distinct 2026-09-04 official WDCB and NVDAB cash-dividend support announcement after every retained rank-34 episode.
trigger.why_source_gate_is_permitted: The new official episode can be rejected at the cheapest independent source gate without asserting that snapshot timing or positive net economics are already proved.

question: Do the exact current official WDCB and NVDAB terms bind a strictly positive conservative net distribution after every withholding tax, fee, cost, and other deduction, as required before any issuer-calendar or market-data work?

endpoint_classification.operation: download one exact public official Binance announcement by article code
endpoint_classification.security: public unauthenticated read-only CMS GET used by prior retained official announcement contracts
endpoint_classification.source_contract: The public Binance support detail route identifies this exact article code and exposes no account, credential, order, or mutation semantics.

gate_order: exact current conservative net-distribution floor must be strictly positive
official exchange ex-dividend adjustment must materially follow the bStock snapshot
pre-snapshot perpetual adjustment ordering must be confirmed
only then may one synchronized finite-size event-time book batch be frozen
positive_floor_requirements: an exact positive gross cash amount per bStock unit
a finite current upper bound or complete formula for applicable withholding taxes
a finite current upper bound or complete formula for every fee cost and other deduction
a deterministic positive lower bound on the final reinvested units or multiplier increment
economic_decision.fail_closed_rule: If any positive-floor requirement is absent, unspecified, discretionary, or unbounded, set the public conservative net-distribution floor to zero and terminalize both exact episodes before issuer dates, books, funding, accounts, credentials, orders, or funds.

retry_policy: This exact article-code GET is one-use. Preserve any HTTP, phrase, format, or byte-limit failure and do not retry an alias. A passing source capture does not satisfy rank 34 unless the frozen positive-floor gate also passes; discovery cannot authorize rushed pre-suspension funding or trading.
